# Andrew Piddoubny (D): NYS Senate, District 5

Independent, source-by-source review of the claims on **Andrew Piddoubny's** campaign website ([campaign home page (single page)](https://www.andrewfornysenate.com/)), captured **2026-11-26**. Opponent: [Steven Rhoads](../rhoads-steven/) (R).

**Live site:** <https://rike4545.github.io/LI-CandidateCheck/#/c/piddoubny-andrew> · method: [METHODOLOGY.md](../../METHODOLOGY.md)

> Scope: this review tests whether each claim is **verifiable** and **accurate as stated**. It does not rate the candidate, the opponent, or policy positions.

## Bottom line

A one-page site with a short biography and issue statements. None of the biographical details could be confirmed from public records; the issue section makes general points without figures.

1. No public record was found of his law clerkship or Ukrainian American Bar Association presidency.
2. The issue section contains no numbers to test.
